summary: Host synced repos with httpd: install `httpd`, set `DocumentRoot` and a `<Directory>` block in `/etc/httpd/conf.d/repository.conf`, `chown -R apache`, label with `semanage fcontext -t httpd_sys_content_t` and `restorecon`, enable httpd, open http/https in firewalld, and add `/etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo` entries for Local-BaseOS and Local-AppStream on the AAP hosts.
questions: How do I host a local RPM repo for disconnected AAP?
SELinux context for a repo directory served by httpd
local.repo example for BaseOS and AppStream

answer_card.title: Serve repos with httpd
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo dnf install httpd
sudo chown -R apache /path/to/repos
sudo semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t "/path/to/repos(/.*)?"
sudo restorecon -ir /path/to/repos
sudo systemctl enable --now httpd.service
sudo firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-service=http --add-service=https --permanent
sudo firewall-cmd --reload
```
On AAP hosts, `/etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo`:
```ini
[Local-BaseOS]
name=Local BaseOS
baseurl=http://<webserver_fqdn>/rhel-9-for-x86_64-baseos-rpms
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release
```
Add a matching `[Local-AppStream]`.
